description: PROPOSED (ODR-COMP-P17) process-evidence rules of the 7 November competition (kemiller2002/causa): Rehearsal 010's rules (kickoff/rehearsal-010/process-evidence-rules.json, rulesSha256 36172c57…, ODR-R10-14 A, APR-R10-OWNER-1) with exactly one change, repository indy-init-rehearsal-010 -> causa-t0, the Praxis project id conditor init recorded at T0 in the competition repository's ros.json and .ros (every one of its Praxis events says repository causa-t0, so with Rehearsal 010's rules requirements-compiler verify-process marks every record INCORRECT-REPOSITORY). The owner, agents, reviewers, automation, review roles and owner decisions are unchanged. requirements-compiler verify-process judges every record-bound obligation against these rules. They take effect only when the owner records ODR-COMP-P17 A and ODR-COMP-LOCK A (owner-freeze.fsx decide competition) and commits kickoff/competition/toolchain.lock.json naming this file with its SHA-256 (processEvidence.rules, rulesSha256); until then the competition lock names Rehearsal 010's rules. Agents never pin them.
